coordinate_system: Isaac world, z up, mujoco body order
goal_provenance: dataset motion, fixed before generation, endpoint at 4 seconds
time_alignment: action k uses reference frame k; next observation requests k+1; 120 frames with no duplicate frame0
semantics: dataset text, independent generated semantics not yet verified
initialization_fix: reset before anchoring; fixed environment seed; no redundant rigid-body refresh
passive_sensor_scope: solver constraints only, world frame; articulated internal constraints may contribute; not ground-truth contact
native_contact_scope: Dense manifold diagnostics disabled after calibration; native body COM and frozen surface-proxy metrics retained
completion_fence_protocol: fetch_results(True) immediately after every native simulate including reset warmup; no extra simulate or tensor refresh
tensor_export_route: CPU native exports, explicit unchanged CUDA mirrors; GPU PhysX and frozen CUDA models
observation_trace_scope: Raw task obs before action; exact returned reference velocity and previous pose, not normalized policy observation
reference_velocity_rule: Successive applied canonical positions / s_dt; first frame zero; repeated query preserves previous; diagnostic amendment, not innovation
